name: PM-DAKSH Rural Self-Employment & Enterprise Scheme
description: Flagship scheme under Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment offering skill training linked credit and capital grant up to ₹10 Lakh at 5% interest rate for rural youth belonging to SC, OBC, EBC, DNT and Safai Karamchari families.
nodalAgency: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
targetAudience: SC, OBC, EBC, DNT, and Safai Karamchari youth establishing rural micro-enterprises
requiredDocuments: PM-DAKSH Skill Certificate or Vocational Training Proof
